capabilities: Share a note as a themed web page via a link
Encrypt note content with a per-note key in the share link
Render Obsidian content types including Dataview queries, callouts, checkboxes and internal links
Let readers save the note's Markdown source back into their vault
Self-host the sharing server with a Docker image
disambiguation: Not a file sharing service; it shares note content, and attachments are uploaded unencrypted.
extras: Includes developer-policy transparency disclosures (network requests, base64 encoding, clipboard write-only access). Encryption covers note text but not attachments; troubleshooting and system status are on external pages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to instantly share a single note as a themed web page that renders Dataview, callouts and internal links and that only the link holder can decrypt.

relations.evidence: Here's an example inline Dataview query. It will be correctly rendered when sharing

summary: Publishes a note to the web with your full theme and rendered content, encrypted by default with the decryption key embedded in the share link.
